svg.title: How a change in Paperless reaches Nextcloud within seconds
svg.desc: A workflow of Paperless with the triggers Document Added and Document Updated calls the webhook of the app with the ID of the document and the secret. A call without the secret is refused with 401, and Nextcloud delays the next calls from that address. With the secret, the app reads that document from Paperless with its own token and exports, moves or removes its copy by the rules of a run, while Paperless waits for the answer. While another run is active, or when the settings say so, the document waits for the next background jobs instead. Trashed and deleted documents stay with the scheduled runs.
